label: Synthetic demo: LUNA18 (paluratide) macrocycle (HCD)
description: A synthetic mzML (not real data) for the 11-residue N-methylated cyclic peptide LUNA18 / paluratide, C73H105F5N12O12, 1436.7897 Da: 1 MS1 and 12 HCD MS2 scans built from predicted ring-opening b/a ions with 1.5 ppm noise. The sequence is written the way it is in PDB 7YV1 (Maa = N-Me-Ala, W2 = azetidine-2-carboxylic acid, Vn = N-ethyl-4-methyl-Phe, Sar, O2a = 3,5-difluoro-4-CF3-homoPhe, Ac5 = 1-aminocyclopentanecarboxylic acid, Vu = N-Me-cyclopentylglycine, Mad = N-Me-Asp dimethylamide, Mle = N-Me-Leu).
